_comment: Transmit-scheduling offload by driver. This table is a hint, not a measurement.
nicscope will not dry-run a `tc qdisc replace` to find out, because that changes
the queue discipline of a live interface, and section 7 of the specification
forbids a write. When `tc qdisc show` reports an offload as configured, the
Values: yes | no | unknown. Add your own rows and send a pull request.

igc.note: Intel I225 and I226. Launch time and the 802.1Qbv gate schedule are both offloaded.

igb.note: Intel I210 has a launch-time engine. Confirm on your own silicon before you rely on it.

stmmac.note: Synopsys DesignWare, used on many embedded SoC ports.

ice.note: Intel E810. Capability depends on the DDP package and the firmware. Verify.

hv_netvsc.note: Hyper-V virtual NIC. No hardware behind it.

virtio_net.note: Virtual NIC. No hardware behind it.
